name: omnitax-engines
description: Deterministic e-invoicing and tax-compliance engines: exact minor-unit money math (zero float drift), statutory XML validation (FatturaPA, TEIF, ZATCA UBL 2.1, FacturX/Peppol BIS 3.0), official-gateway sandbox simulators (SdI, TTN, ZATCA, ETA rejection codes), an append-only SHA-256 WORM Merkle audit ledger, multi-tenant row-level isolation, Idempotency-Key middleware, and production-grade HTTP API with OpenAPI 3.1 contract. No LLM ever touches statutory arithmetic.

scripts.test: node tests/test_decimal_and_idempotency.js && node tests/test_worm_and_tenant_isolation.js && node tests/test_xsd_and_sandbox_gateways.js

author: Kais
